hypothesis: Adding Cognitive Architecture Mapping (Phase 4) to voice capture — argument construction pattern, humor deployment logic, vulnerability architecture — will produce voice profiles that capture HOW someone thinks, not just what they sound like
test_task: Capture the voice DNA of an S&C coach from a 5-minute voice memo for Authority Flywheel content production
notes: 3 structural dimensions added: Argument Construction Pattern (6 types with primary/secondary ratio as fingerprint), Humor Deployment Logic (type/trigger/recovery/frequency/boundaries), Vulnerability Architecture (depth gradient/entry pattern/trigger topics/recovery move/boundary markers). Baseline captured surface style; variant captures cognitive DNA. Created first workflow for this skill (had 0). Key insight: the primary/secondary argument pattern RATIO is the real fingerprint — most people oscillate between two patterns and the ratio is unique.
new_cognitive_layer: Cognitive Architecture Mapping — structural analysis of how someone constructs arguments, deploys humor, and reveals vulnerability
